title: MNRL matches of the DP's accounts (NSDL e-PASS)
purpose: NSDL's DP-ID-wise list of demat accounts whose mobile number is on DoT's MNRL: e-PASS > iAssist > Download > View/Search - BSDA/MNRL/Email Bounce, the DP ID, file type MNRL, the month and year. NSDL does not publish the columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when e-PASS's differs).
linked: Matched with the DP's NSDL accounts and their holders' mobiles on Clients & onboarding → Revoked mobiles.
source: NSDL/POLICY/2026/0090 (16 Jun 2026): NSDL gives DP-ID-wise MNRL matches on e-PASS (Annexure A: e-PASS > iAssist > Download > View/Search - BSDA/MNRL/Email Bounce). The circular's exhibits are screenshots; no column layout is published.
